# Golden Arch (graduation, #17)

Built from the owner's poster (Canva, "Green and White Elegant Wedding Invitation", graduation version), rendered here as
`poster.webp`. The poster's text is outlined, so its artwork was taken out as layers and its lettering matched with
open-licensed fonts.

## Layers (from the poster SVG)

| Asset | Poster layer | Placement on the poster (% of width / height) |
|---|---|---|
| `paper.webp` | the top-left flowers stretched over the whole poster at 10 % strength | full page |
| `roses-top.webp` | white roses and eucalyptus, top left | left −14.8 %, top −3.8 %, width 56.3 % |
| `roses-bottom.webp` | white roses, bottom right (turned 70.4°, as on the poster) | right and bottom edges |
| `hands.webp` | line-drawn hands throwing caps | left 0, bottom −2.3 %, width 33.9 % |
| `laurel-cap.webp` | gold laurel with the cap | inside the arch, width 31.4 % |
| gold arch | vector: half-circle top, 13.9 % / 14.2 % from the sides, 10.8 % / 11 % from top and bottom, stroke 1.2 % of the width | drawn in code with the poster's gradient (#a67a12 → #f2df77 → #fff7bc → #dac37e → #935e00 → #eab30e, diagonal) |

## Type

Forum (the name, the date and time), Montserrat (the spaced capitals), Pinyon Script (the script line), Amiri and
Noto Sans Arabic for Arabic and Kurdish. All SIL OFL (`themes/golden-arch/v1/fonts/OFL-*.txt`).

## Opening

Closed: the paper, the laurel, "Celebrating the graduation of", the name and the open button; the flowers rest just
outside their corners. On open: the gold arch draws itself up both sides from the bottom and meets at the top (1.5 s),
the roses bloom in from their corners, the hands toss their caps, and the details settle line by line inside the arch
(to 2.6 s). Reduced motion: shown at once.

## Photographs

The portrait arch on the website holds the laurel and the year. When photographs become a package, the graduate's
photograph fills that arch (no other layout change).
